adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh flow was added/changed to call `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` directly and then `parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)`, but it never uses the new `refreshOAuthTokens(...)` helper that conditionally redirects refreshes to `process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is true. In contrast, multiple other integrations in this diff (Google, Office365, Hubspot, Lark, Webex, Zoom, Zoho, etc.) were updated to go through `refreshOAuthTokens`. Therefore, with credential sharing enabled + sync endpoint configured, Salesforce refreshes will not be redirected/synced, causing inconsistent/out-of-sync behavior relative to the rest of the changes.
